proves.claim: The MAIN_NOT_COMPOSED hint says to run pullboard submit again because submit composes current main, with no merge instruction and no setting name.

moves.submit-merge-hints.main-not-compos.why: A builder is told to merge main only on a real conflict, and the hint must hold with submit.composeAsObject on or off.

proves.claim: The STALE_VERDICT and VERDICT_TRUNK_MOVED hints and the STALE_VERDICT next line ask for a submit and a re-review against current main, with no merge instruction and no setting name.

moves.submit-merge-hints.stale-verdict-a.why: A stale or trunk-moved verdict is cured by a resubmit and a fresh review, not by a builder merge.

proves.claim: The submit and verify MERGE_CONFLICT hints still tell the builder to merge main into the branch and resolve the conflict.

moves.submit-merge-hints.merge-conflict-.why: A real Git conflict is the one case where a builder must merge main.
